description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of activated parameters (expressed as a ratio in percentage) and the evaluation performance in terms of PPL (Perplexity) for four different models: Transformer, Only MoHD FFN, Only MoHD ATTN, and MoHD ATTN + MLP. The x-axis represents the activated parameters ratio, ranging from 100% to 25%, with tick marks at 100, 75, 50, and 25, and is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio (%)". The y-axis represents the evaluation PPL, ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick marks at 11.5, 12.0, 12.5, 13.0, 13.5, and 14.0. The Transformer model is represented by a dashed red line, which remains nearly flat at a PPL of approximately 11.6 across all parameter ratios. The Only MoHD FFN model is shown with a gray line and square markers, starting at a PPL of about 11.6 at 100% activation, decreasing to approximately 11.5 at 50%, and then rising to about 11.7 at 25%. The Only MoHD ATTN model is depicted by a dark blue line with circle markers, starting at a PPL of around 11.6 at 100%, increasing to about 12.2 at 50%, and then sharply rising to approximately 14.1 at 25%. The MoHD ATTN + MLP model is represented by a light blue line with star markers, starting at a PPL of about 11.6 at 100%, increasing to approximately 12.1 at 75%, and then rising to about 13.1 at 25%.
